name: Middlebury station
summary: The Amtrak platform where the train ride ends and the greeter is waiting. Third-person play starts here.

facts.text: Middlebury station (Amtrak MBY) is at 30 Middle Seymour Street. It is a platform stop on the Ethan Allen Express and has been open since July 29, 2022.
Amtrak lists the Middlebury, Vermont stop as accessible.
The Middlebury Campus reported in 2023 that the station is about a mile, roughly a twenty-minute walk, from campus.

name: Triangle Park
summary: You pass through here on the way from the station to campus. Later it is the door back into town. Calling it the official campus boundary is the game's framing, not a sourced claim.

facts.text: Great American Stations describes Triangle Park as the corner once cut off by the railroad: a plaza with a fountain and a grassy area edged by stone blocks used as seating, near the north end of town.
The station's history notes that the 2020 rail tunnel created Triangle Park next to St. Stephen's Episcopal Church.

name: Arrival Green
summary: A gameplay stand-in for the moment you arrive. It is not a claim that this lawn has that official name.

facts.text: As of the college orientation pages fetched 2026-10-27, in-person orientation is Fall Orientation or Feb Orientation, where new students meet classmates and orientation leaders.
The orientation FAQ fetched 2026-10-27 said Fall Orientation and Feb Orientation run from Wednesday through Sunday.
The college orientation page says new students may square dance and calls that a Middlebury tradition.

name: First-year halls
summary: The cluster of halls where most first-year students live. Your assigned building is the next door in.

facts.text: The admitted-student page fetched 2026-10-27 said first-year students will most likely live in Stewart, Hepburn, Allen, Coffrin, or New Battell.

name: Your hall
summary: A generic interior for whichever first-year hall you were assigned. The game does not know your real room.

facts.text: The admitted-student page lists a residence director or assistant among the people who support first-years.

name: Proctor Dining Hall
summary: One of the campus dining halls.

facts.text: The admitted-student page fetched 2026-10-27 said the dining plan allows unlimited meals at Proctor, Atwater, and Ross.
That same page named retail spots: the Grille, Crossroads in the Davis Library, So-full Sips in Bicentennial Hall, the S.E.A. Dinette, and Midd Express.

name: Atwater Dining Hall
summary: One of the three dining halls named for unlimited meals.

facts.text: The admitted-student page fetched 2026-10-27 said unlimited meals include Atwater, along with Proctor and Ross.

name: Ross Dining Hall
summary: One of the three dining halls named for unlimited meals.

facts.text: The admitted-student page fetched 2026-10-27 said unlimited meals include Ross, along with Proctor and Atwater.

name: Davis Family Library
summary: The library node. Crossroads Café is the sourced detail here; the rest of the building tour is still a sample.

facts.text: The admitted-student page fetched 2026-10-27 described Crossroads as the student-run café in the Davis Library.

name: McCardell Bicentennial Hall
summary: Academic building node. Only the café line is verified; classrooms inside are reached through the seminar room.

facts.text: The admitted-student page fetched 2026-10-27 described So-full Sips as the café in Bicentennial Hall.

name: Sample seminar room
summary: A sample classroom for the lesson bridge. It is not a numbered Middlebury classroom and not an official section.

facts.text: The admitted-student page says first-years are supported by their first-year seminar professor, who is also the pre-major advisor.

name: Activities fair
summary: A sample fair where interest quests are offered. It does not list a live schedule of student organizations.

facts.text: The admitted-student page fetched 2026-10-27 named a support team that includes the first-year seminar professor and pre-major advisor, a Compass Mentor, a student orientation leader, and a residence director or assistant.

name: Downtown
summary: A locked stand-in for the town of Middlebury. No shops are named until a sourced content pass.

name: Outdoors
summary: A locked stand-in for trails and the country around campus. No trail is named yet.

name: Your room
summary: A generic first-year room. Unpack here and place a few doodads. Not a real student's room.

name: Movie theater
summary: A locked stand-in for the downtown movie theater. No business name until a sourced pass.

name: Middlebury Snow Bowl
summary: A later trip, not a walk from the dorm. Optional minigame once it is open.

facts.text: A Middlebury walking-history page describes the Snow Bowl as farther east on Route 125, past the Bread Loaf campus in Ripton, and open in the skiing season. Do not treat that page's lift or trail counts as current.
